known_secrets.text: Several years ago Balamitra woke in the middle of the night and checked the stone heirloom.
When asked about it, he refused to explain.
Lalita once found an old note hidden among Balamitra's belongings: 'If the Song is broken, the Key must remain hidden.'
She secretly kept the note. Balamitra believes it was lost.

unknowns: What happened during the old city's fall
